map.推理吞吐估算是做什么的？: What does Inference Throughput Estimator do?
map.如何使用推理吞吐估算？: How do I use Inference Throughput Estimator?
map.推理吞吐估算适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Inference Throughput Estimator best for?
map.由生成 token 与时延估算推理吞吐。: Estimate inference throughput from generated tokens and latency.
map.吞吐 = tokens / 秒；单请求吞吐 = tokens / (秒 × 并发: Throughput = tokens / sec; per-request throughput = tokens / (sec x concurrency batch)
map.推理服务的核心指标：总吞吐衡量集群利用率，单请求吞吐才是用户感知的快慢。batc: A core metric for inference serving: total throughput measures cluster utilization, while per-request throughput is what users feel as speed. Batching greatly raises total throughput but lengthens per-request latency, so online services usually trade off between them by SLO.
map.吞吐 = tokens / 耗时；人均 = 吞吐 / 并发: Throughput = tokens / elapsed; per-request = throughput / concurrency
map.实际受批大小与排队影响。: Affected in practice by batch size and queuing.
map.吞吐≈生成 token 数 / 端到端时延(tokens/s)，衡量服务处理速度: Throughput ~ generated tokens / end-to-end latency (tokens/s), measuring serving speed.
map.受模型大小、批大小、KV 缓存与硬件带宽共同影响，非仅由 FLOPs 决定。: Driven jointly by model size, batch size, KV cache and hardware bandwidth, not solely by FLOPs.
map.容量规划用 吞吐×并发上限 估算峰值 QPS，需预留余量防雪崩。: For capacity planning, peak QPS ~ throughput x max concurrency, with headroom reserved against overload.
map.生成 200 token 耗时 4s → 吞吐=50 tokens/s。若单卡支: Generating 200 tokens in 4s -> throughput = 50 tokens/s. If one card supports 4-way concurrency at 50 tok/s each, total ~ 200 tok/s; but with shared KV cache and bandwidth, the concurrency gain is below linear.
map.为什么吞吐不随并发线性增长？: Why does throughput not grow linearly with concurrency?
map.显存带宽与算力是共享瓶颈，多请求竞争 KV 缓存与计算单元，边际吞吐递减；需实测: Memory bandwidth and compute are shared bottlenecks; many requests compete for KV cache and units, so marginal throughput declines. Measure to find the knee before setting the concurrency cap.
map.首 token 延迟和吞吐冲突吗？: Do first-token latency and throughput conflict?
map.常冲突。大模型首 token 受预填充耗时影响，吞吐受解码并行影响；优化方向相反: Often yes. First-token latency is driven by prefill cost, while throughput is driven by decode parallelism; when the optimization directions oppose, choose by business (low latency for chat, high throughput for batch).
